source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Collect all relevant data and information about the audit.
3. Detail the overview of the audit.
4. Identify the areas of non-compliance.
5. Record the specific regulations or standards that were not met.
6. Describe the findings, citing specific examples where possible.
7. Document witnesses and auditory evidence.
8. List the corrective actions recommended by auditors.
9. Provide a summary of the overall safety audit results.
10. Attach related photographic evidence or diagrams where appropriate.
11. Record the names of the auditing team and their credentials.
12. Note the date and time of the audit, as well as the environment/conditions present.
13. Highlight any incidents, injuries, or near misses discovered during the audit.
14. Include quotes from audit participants, if available.
15. Compile all non-conformity reports generated during the audit.
16. Detail the timeline and recommended completion dates for corrective actions.
17. Create a follow-up procedure for re
